name: Hold Your Horses
storyline: There is a field at the bottom of the stream. Each time someone says hello in chat, another horse wanders in to join the herd, and it stays for as long as they do: grazing through the afternoon, racing when the mods call it, and lying down to sleep under the stars when the night comes.
summary:
Hold Your Horses is a pixel-art idle game that runs on Twitch streams. Every viewer who chats gets a horse of their own in a shared field along the bottom of the stream. The horses wander, graze, gallop, roll in the grass, nuzzle one another and lie down to sleep at night, and each viewer's chat messages appear over their horse in speech bubbles.

The field keeps its own clock and weather, from sunny afternoons to rain, snow, fog and thunderstorms, and nineteen events can turn up: carrots raining from the sky, fireworks, a hot air balloon, the northern lights, a disco and a blood moon among them. Moderators can call races across the field, and streamers can tie channel point rewards to it, from making it night to putting a viewer's horse in the spotlight. The field dresses up for the seasons, starting with Halloween.

Viewers earn oats by chatting on the streams that run the game and spend them in the wardrobe: 33 coats, natural and rare, more than 45 hats, glasses, scarves and wings, and entrances, trails and glows, from Common to Legendary. A horse wears its look on every stream it visits. With the Twitch Extension, viewers can click the stream to send their horse anywhere in the field.

Streamers add the field to OBS as a browser source for free, and connect their channel to save their viewers' horses and turn on oats and rewards.
